retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unwanted elevated errors in FedRAMP workspaces/API organisations engage the repair proposition. OpenAI's controlling notice reports all impacted services fully recovered on 26 June after investigation, with the mirrors corroborating the bounded interval. This is affirmative provider-reported evidence of repair for that service-restoration stage. It neither establishes continuous total downtime, underlying technical cause, all individual customer outcomes nor a certification/compliance-control breach.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The occurrence-specific full-service-recovery statement independently identifies OECD appropriate repair mechanisms, even though no taxonomy mechanism is classified.
